entities.summary: The Hardanger Line was a 27.45-kilometre (17.06 mi) railway between Vossevangen and Granvin in Hordaland county, Norway. The line connected to the Bergen Line in Voss Municipality and ran to the Hardangerfjord and the district of Hardanger. Construction started in 1921, but the line did not open until 1 April 1935. Owned and operated by Norwegian State Railways (NSB), passenger transport was provided by three NSB Class 64 electric multiple units. They remained in use until 1985 when passenger transport was terminated.
